One relay per server, every message logged, and the SPF/DKIM/DMARC records checked against live DNS.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Full**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/mail/status`

Relay and signer health, queue depth, reverse-DNS verdicts.

- **Level:** Read only

### `GET /api/mail/messages`

Sent mail, one row per recipient.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?siteSlug=&status=&serverId=&search=&hours=&limit=&offset=`

### `GET /api/mail/stats`

Totals by status, per-hour buckets, per-site volume.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?hours=24`

### `POST /api/mail/ingest`

Parse the relay logs now instead of waiting a minute.

- **Level:** Manage. Only does now what the panel does every minute

### `GET /api/mail/queue`

The postfix queue with a deferral reason per recipient.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?serverId=`

### `POST /api/mail/queue/:serverId/flush`

Retry the whole queue now.

- **Level:** Manage. Only retries the mail already queued

### `DELETE /api/mail/queue/:serverId/:queueId`

Drop one queued message; queueId=ALL empties the queue.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive

### `POST /api/mail/test`

Inject a message into the relay, bypassing WordPress.

- **Level:** Full
- **Input:** `{from, to, serverId?, subject?}`

### `GET /api/mail/setup`

The whole setup guide: mode, rDNS, ports, per-domain record plan.

- **Level:** Read only

### `GET /api/mail/domains`

Per-domain SPF/DKIM/DMARC against live DNS, plus the records to publish.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?domain=`

### `POST /api/mail/domains/:domain/publish`

Publish what can be published safely (SPF merged, DKIM generated, DMARC left alone).

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive

### `POST /api/mail/domains/:domain/check`

Re-check one domain.

- **Level:** Manage. Only re-checks DNS; changes nothing

### `PUT /api/mail/servers/:serverId/hostname`

Change the name the relay announces (applied live, queue untouched).

- **Level:** Full
- **Input:** `{hostname}`

### `DELETE /api/mail/servers/:serverId/hostname`

Put the relay back on its default name, MAIL\_HOSTNAME (applied live).

- **Level:** Full

### `POST /api/mail/servers/:serverId/publish-hostname`

Point the relay hostname's A record at that server.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive

### `GET /api/mail/dkim`

DKIM keys with their DNS record values.

- **Level:** Read only

### `POST /api/mail/dkim`

Generate (or rotate) a key, push it to every server, restart the signers.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `{domain, rotate?}`

### `POST /api/mail/dkim/sync`

Re-materialize every key on every server.

- **Level:** Manage. Only re-copies the keys the panel already holds

### `DELETE /api/mail/dkim/:domain`

Delete a key and its files.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive
